{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module FileService where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as LBS
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import Data.Char (toLower, isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Network.HTTP.Types (status200, status403, status400)
import Network.Wai
import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp (run)
import System.FilePath (takeFileName, (</>))
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

type SessionStore = IORef (Map.Map String (String, UTCTime))

-- Cross-service auth token format: "service:<name>\ntoken:<hex>\nscope:<path>"
data AuthToken = AuthToken
  { authService :: String
  , authTokenVal :: String
  , authScope :: String
  } deriving (Show)

-- Parse the multi-line auth token from the inter-service protocol
parseAuthToken :: String -> Either String AuthToken
parseAuthToken raw =
  let lines' = splitOnNewlines raw
  in case lines' of
    [svc, tok, scp] -> do
      service <- extractField "service" svc
      token <- extractField "token" tok
      scope <- extractField "scope" scp
      Right $ AuthToken service token scope
    _ -> Left "Invalid token format: expected 3 fields"

-- Split on logical newlines for the protocol
splitOnNewlines :: String -> [String]
splitOnNewlines [] = []
splitOnNewlines s =
  let (line, rest) = break isNewlineChar s
  in line : case rest of
    [] -> []
    ('\r':'\n':xs) -> splitOnNewlines xs
    ('\n':xs) -> splitOnNewlines xs
    (x:xs) -> splitOnNewlines xs
  where isNewlineChar c = c == '\n' || c == '\r'

extractField :: String -> String -> Either String String
extractField name s =
  let prefix = name ++ ":"
  in if prefix `isPrefixOf` s
     then Right (drop (length prefix) s)
     else Left $ "Missing field: " ++ name

-- Validate that the token hex is well-formed
validateTokenHex :: String -> Bool
validateTokenHex = all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '-')

-- Scope check: does the requested path fall under the token's scope?
scopeCoversPath :: String -> FilePath -> Bool
scopeCoversPath scope path =
  let normalizedScope = map toLower scope
      normalizedPath = map toLower path
  in normalizedScope `isPrefixOf` normalizedPath

-- Sanitize filename to prevent directory traversal
sanitizeFilename :: String -> Maybe String
sanitizeFilename name
  | ".." `isInfixOf` name = Nothing
  | '/' `elem` name = Nothing
  | '\\' `elem` name = Nothing
  | otherwise = Just name

-- Sanitize a value to prevent CRLF injection in headers
sanitizeHeaderValue :: String -> String
sanitizeHeaderValue = filter (\c -> c /= '\r' && c /= '\n')

-- Build the response header for downstream services
buildResponseHeader :: AuthToken -> FilePath -> String
buildResponseHeader token path =
  "X-Processed-By: file-service\r\n" ++
  "X-Auth-Service: " ++ sanitizeHeaderValue (authService token) ++ "\r\n" ++
  "X-File-Path: " ++ sanitizeHeaderValue path ++ "\r\n" ++
  "X-Scope: " ++ sanitizeHeaderValue (authScope token) ++ "\r\n"

-- The core file processing handler
processFileRequest :: SessionStore -> String -> String -> IO (Either String (String, String))
processFileRequest store rawToken filename = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  case parseAuthToken rawToken of
    Left err -> return $ Left $ "Auth error: " ++ err
    Right token -> do
      if not (validateTokenHex (authTokenVal token))
        then return $ Left "Invalid token format"
        else case sanitizeFilename filename of
          Nothing -> return $ Left "Invalid filename"
          Just safeName -> do
            let fullPath = "/data/files" </> safeName
            if not (scopeCoversPath (authScope token) fullPath)
              then return $ Left "Scope violation"
              else do
                let headers = buildResponseHeader token fullPath
                let body = "File content placeholder for: " ++ fullPath
                return $ Right (headers, body)

-- HTTP endpoint adapter
app :: SessionStore -> Application
app store req respond = do
  let method = requestMethod req
      path = BS.unpack $ rawPathInfo req
      headers = requestHeaders req
  case lookup "X-Service-Auth" headers of
    Nothing -> respond $ responseLBS status403 [] "Missing auth"
    Just authHeader -> do
      let rawToken = BS.unpack authHeader
          filename = drop 1 path -- strip leading /
      result <- processFileRequest store rawToken filename
      case result of
        Left err -> respond $ responseLBS status400 [] (LBS.pack err)
        Right (respHeaders, body) -> do
          respond $ responseLBS status200
            [("Content-Type", "text/plain"), ("X-Internal-Headers", BS.pack respHeaders)]
            (LBS.pack body)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  store <- newIORef Map.empty
  putStrLn "File service starting on port 8080"
  run 8080 (app store)
